title: Days Supply and Split-Fill Dispensing Table — Northbridge Specialty Tiers
content:
Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy dispenses within the per-fill supply limits shown below for each Specialty Pharmacy Program tier. Each tier also states whether it runs the split-fill program. Under that program the first fills of selected drugs are dispensed as partial supplies, which limits waste if the drug is stopped.

## Supply per fill

| Tier | Maximum days supply per specialty fill | Drugs a stable member may receive above 30 days |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | 30 | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | 30 | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | 30 | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | 30 | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | 30 | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | 90 | Biktarvy |

A stable member may receive more than 30 days only of a drug on the tier's list, and only up to the tier's maximum. On Northbridge Specialty Total Care that drug is Biktarvy, up to 90 days.

## Split-fill program

| Tier | Split-fill program | Split-fill drugs | Initial months dispensed as split fills | Days supply of each partial fill | Member pays a prorated share of the 30-day cost share on each partial fill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | No | Ibrance | 0 | 0 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | No | Ibrance | 0 | 0 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | Yes | Ibrance | 3 | 15 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | Yes | Ibrance | 3 | 15 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | Yes | Ibrance | 3 | 14 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | Yes | Ibrance | 3 | 14 | Yes |

Where the split-fill program does not run, the months and days-supply figures are 0.

## The prorated share, worked through

Where proration applies, the member's share on a partial fill is the 30-day cost share multiplied by the partial fill's days supply and divided by 30.

*Illustration on assumed figures:* the 30-day cost share is $90.00.
- A 15-day partial fill on Northbridge Specialty Exclusive is charged 15 thirtieths of $90.00, which is $45.00.
- A 14-day partial fill on Northbridge Specialty Total Care is charged 14 thirtieths of $90.00, which is $42.00.
